info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Internal Network Operation Operational Action-spec
info.description: The Internal Network Operation Management API facilitates the creation of operational actions for internal network operations within banking IT management. This endpoint allows users to register new actions that enhance network operation efficiency and management oversight. Typical consumers include IT administrators and operations teams responsible for maintaining network integrity and performance. By utilizing this API, organizations can streamline their internal processes and improve collaboration across IT operations.

post.summary: Execute operational actions for internal network management.
post.description: This endpoint allows users to initiate various operational actions related to the management and performance of the internal network. It enables processing requests that impact the efficiency and effectiveness of the network operations.
